title: Ice Maker Fan Motor Error
shortDescription: Ice maker fan motor circuit failure detected.
fullDescription:
The ER1F error indicates the ice maker fan motor is not operating correctly. This fan circulates cold air over the ice maker compartment.

Without proper airflow, ice production drops and the control board logs the fault.

Causes include seized fan, wiring issues, or a failed control board.

fixSteps.title: Access ice maker fan
fixSteps.instruction: Remove freezer panel to expose the fan motor.

fixSteps.title: Test fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Spin blade by hand and check continuity.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Swap in new motor and reconnect wiring.

whenToCallPro: If board replacement is needed or if sealed system suspected.

faq.q: Can I still use the fridge?
faq.a: Yes, but ice production will be affected.

title: Freezer Sensor Error
shortDescription: Freezer temperature sensor has failed or shorted.
fullDescription:
ER2 means the freezer thermistor is reading out of range. The control board cannot determine freezer temperature.

The compressor may run continuously or not at all as a protective response.

Usually fixed by replacing the thermistor.
symptoms: Freezer too warm or too cold

fixSteps.title: Locate freezer thermistor
fixSteps.instruction: It is usually on the back wall of freezer.

fixSteps.title: Test resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Should read about 16kOhm at freezer temps.

whenToCallPro: If replacement thermistor does not clear error.
videoSearchQuery: Kenmore refrigerator ER2 freezer sensor fix

faq.a: Monitor temp closely and transfer if freezer climbs.

title: Freezer Fan Error
shortDescription: Evaporator fan in freezer not running correctly.
fullDescription:
ERFF indicates the freezer evaporator fan is not meeting expected RPM. This fan moves cold air through the freezer and into the fresh food compartment.

Ice buildup, a seized motor, or iced-over blades are common causes.

Defrosting and replacing the fan usually resolves it.

fixSteps.title: Remove freezer back panel
fixSteps.instruction: Unscrew rear panel to access fan.

fixSteps.title: Defrost ice buildup
fixSteps.instruction: Use hair dryer carefully to clear ice.

fixSteps.title: Test or replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Check continuity or install new fan motor.

whenToCallPro: If ice keeps reforming suggesting defrost circuit issue.

faq.a: No, but food may spoil if not addressed.

title: Ice Maker Sensor Error
shortDescription: Ice maker sensor reading is out of range.
fullDescription:
ERIS signals a fault with the ice maker temperature sensor. The control cannot confirm when the ice tray is cold enough to harvest.

You may see reduced or no ice production.

Replacement of the sensor typically clears the fault.

fixSteps.title: Remove ice maker
fixSteps.instruction: Unclip and lower ice maker assembly.

fixSteps.title: Install replacement
fixSteps.instruction: Swap in new sensor or ice maker unit.

whenToCallPro: If ice maker is integrated with board and unsure of wiring.
videoSearchQuery: Kenmore refrigerator ERIS ice maker sensor

faq.a: Yes via the ice maker switch to silence error.

title: Condenser Fan Error
shortDescription: Condenser fan motor not reaching expected speed.
fullDescription:
ERCF indicates the condenser fan, located near the compressor, is not running correctly. It is critical for cooling the compressor and condenser coils.

Ignoring the code can lead to compressor overheating.

Clean debris or replace the motor.

fixSteps.title: Access rear compartment
fixSteps.instruction: Pull fridge out and remove rear panel.

fixSteps.title: Clean fan and coils
fixSteps.instruction: Vacuum and brush dust from condenser.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan if needed
fixSteps.instruction: Install a new condenser fan motor if failed.

whenToCallPro: If new motor does not clear code.

faq.q: How often should I clean coils?
faq.a: Every 6 months to prevent dust buildup.

title: Defrost Heater Error
shortDescription: Defrost heater circuit open or shorted.
fullDescription:
ERDH indicates a problem with the defrost heater in the freezer. When defrost cycles cannot heat properly, ice builds up on the evaporator.

This reduces cooling efficiency and triggers secondary faults.

Test and replace the heater element.
whenToCallPro: If uncomfortable handling evaporator and sealed system.

faq.a: Yes, unplug for 24 hours as a temporary fix.

title: Room Temperature Sensor Error
fullDescription:
ERRT means the room temperature sensor has failed. Kenmore uses this sensor to adjust compressor runtime based on ambient conditions.

When faulty, the fridge may run warmer or cooler than needed.

Replacement of the ambient thermistor resolves it.

fixSteps.title: Locate ambient sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Usually near control panel or hinge.

whenToCallPro: If error persists after replacement.

faq.a: Not immediately but will affect efficiency.

title: Fresh Food Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E1 is triggered when the fresh food compartment sensor is outside normal resistance range. The control board cannot accurately regulate fridge temperature.

Food spoilage risk increases the longer it stays uncorrected.

fixSteps.title: Remove sensor cover
fixSteps.instruction: Cover is in top of fresh food compartment.

whenToCallPro: If sensor swap fails to clear code.

faq.a: Yes but check temperatures manually.

title: Freezer Sensor Fault
fullDescription:
E2 indicates a problem with the freezer thermistor. The control board receives no usable signal from the sensor.

Freezer temperatures may become unstable and food can thaw.
whenToCallPro: If replacement does not help.

faq.a: Yes, monitor temperatures closely.

title: Defrost Sensor Error
fullDescription:
E3 signals a defrost sensor malfunction. This sensor monitors evaporator temperature during defrost cycles.

Bad readings can cause extended defrost or failure to defrost.
whenToCallPro: If sealed system suspected.

faq.a: Unplugging for 24h provides temporary relief.

title: Freezer Fan Lock
shortDescription: Freezer fan locked or not turning.
fullDescription:
FF indicates the freezer fan is locked. This is usually caused by frost buildup or a failed motor.

Without airflow, the freezer cannot maintain temperature.
whenToCallPro: If ice keeps returning.

faq.a: Yes, using hair dryer carefully on low heat.

title: System Communication Error
fullDescription:
SY indicates a system communication fault. The main and sub boards cannot exchange data properly.

Causes range from loose connectors to failed boards.

Try a power cycle first.
whenToCallPro: If board replacement required and unfamiliar with electronics.

faq.a: Sometimes, worth trying first.
